meta.title: Start onboarding for multiple prospects at once

steps.note: Ensure the required onboarding capability is enabled for the test tenant.

args.goal: Open the Prospects tab, select three prospects, verify the Start Onboarding button shows 3, click Start Onboarding, choose an Onboarding Template, verify the side panel lists the three selected prospects, confirm, and stop when all three prospects are shown under Onboarding in Progress

steps.note: The catalog has no domain step for the Prospects bulk-onboarding flow, so perform the complete buyer-side interaction and verify its visible outcomes.
Assert that exactly the three selected prospects moved into the Onboarding in Progress list.
